column1: # What each corpus file's front ends said, written by
# This exists so that "has this file ever been through both front ends"
# can be answered by something with no oracle installed. The gate over it
# and it checks **membership only** — that every file the differential
# enumerates has a row and every row names a file that still exists. It
# does not check that the verdicts below are today's; the differential
# itself is the only thing that can, and it rewrites this file whole.
# 오라클이 설치되지 않은 곳에서도 "이 파일이 두 프런트엔드를 거쳤는가"를
# 답할 수 있게 하는 기록이다. 게이트는 **소속만** 검사한다 — 아래 판정이
# 오늘의 것인지는 differential 자신만 말할 수 있고, 매번 전체를 다시 쓴다.
# Columns: file <TAB> filed as <TAB> our verdict <TAB> each oracle's verdict
